company_name: The Foundation of Encourage Nagasaki Industry
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides materials and components relevant to semiconductor manufacturing but is primarily focused on supporting small and medium-sized enterprises.
summary: The Foundation of Encourage Nagasaki Industry supports the development of semiconductor-related technologies and components, including custom ICs, machined products, and various materials for semiconductor manufacturing. They also facilitate the procurement of overseas materials and provide high-precision machining services.
capabilities: Development of 10kW output three-phase bridgeless active filters
Mini custom ICs for dedicated circuits
Machined aluminum products and semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts
